newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Shaving gains on Bombay bourse.
newsitem.headline: Indian Shaving gains on Bombay bourse.

text.p: Shares of Indian Shaving climbed 16 rupees, or 3.2 percent, to 516 in early trade on the Bombay bourse on Thursday, traders said.
They said retail investors were buyers in the stock after the firm announced improved results for 1996/97 (April-March) earlier this week.
Indian Shavings said its net profit rose to 51.5 million rupees, from 36.6 million in the previous year.
Net sales climbed to 1.19 billion rupees, from 833 million in 1995/96.
